literal: Winter, tenth month, on xinhai day the court went to the Central Capital.
idiomatic: On xinhai day of the tenth winter month the court went to the Central Capital.

literal: Intercalary month, on dingmao day Longyou was posthumously granted Grand Preceptor and given the posthumous title Renxiao.
idiomatic: On dingmao day of the intercalary month Longyou was posthumously granted Grand Preceptor and given the posthumous title Renxiao.

literal: Eleventh month, on the jiawu new moon, civil and military officials bestowed the honorific Hongwen Xuanwu Zundao Zhide Chongren Guangxiao Congrui Zhaosheng Shenzan Tianfu Emperor.
idiomatic: On the jiawu new moon of the eleventh month civil and military officials bestowed on the Emperor the honorific Hongwen Xuanwu Zundao Zhide Chongren Guangxiao Congrui Zhaosheng Shenzan Tianfu Emperor.

literal: A general amnesty was proclaimed and the era name changed to Kaitai.
idiomatic: A general amnesty was proclaimed and the era name was changed to Kaitai.

literal: Youdu Prefecture was changed to Xijin Prefecture, Jibei County to Xijin County, Youdu County to Wanping County, and grace extended at home and abroad.
idiomatic: Youdu Prefecture was renamed Xijin Prefecture, Jibei County was renamed Xijin County, Youdu County was renamed Wanping County, and grace was extended throughout the realm.

literal: On jihai day the Western Xia envoys and Eastern Head Serving Official Cao Wenbin, Lü Wengui, Dou Guiyou, Shou Rong, Wu Yuanzheng, and others were granted ranks in varying measure.
idiomatic: On jihai day the Western Xia envoys and Eastern Head Serving Official Cao Wenbin, Lü Wengui, Dou Guiyou, Shou Rong, Wu Yuanzheng, and others were granted ranks in varying measure.

literal: On guimao day former Liaozhou clerk Zhang Tingmei had six generations living together, and Yikun Prefecture's Liu Xingyin had four generations living together; each was granted three years' tax exemption.
idiomatic: On guimao day former Liaozhou clerk Zhang Tingmei, who had six generations living together, and Yikun Prefecture's Liu Xingyin, who had four generations living together, were each granted three years' tax exemption.

literal: On jiachen day Northwestern Road pacification commissioner Xiao Tuyu reported that Seven Tribes Grand Preceptor Alidi, because of his people's resentment, killed native military commissioner Ba An and slaughtered his family in rebellion; the Zubu captured Alidi and presented him, while frontier tribes all rebelled.
idiomatic: On jiachen day Northwestern Road pacification commissioner Xiao Tuyu reported that Seven Tribes Grand Preceptor Alidi, because of resentment among his people, had killed native military commissioner Ba An and slaughtered his family in rebellion; the Zubu captured Alidi and presented him, while frontier tribes all rebelled.

literal: Twelfth month, on bingyin day stone statues of the emperors from Nanjing were ceremonially moved to Guande Hall at the Central Capital, and Emperor Jingzong and Empress Xuanxian to Wuluan Hall at the Upper Capital.
idiomatic: On bingyin day of the twelfth month stone statues of the emperors from Nanjing were ceremonially moved to Guande Hall at the Central Capital, and Emperor Jingzong and Empress Xuanxian to Wuluan Hall at the Upper Capital.

literal: On renshen day famine victims of Fengsheng Prefecture were relieved.
idiomatic: On renshen day famine victims of Fengsheng Prefecture were relieved.

literal: On gengchen day the Emperor's younger brother King of Qin-Jin Longqing was granted an iron tally of privilege.
idiomatic: On gengchen day the Emperor's younger brother King of Qin-Jin Longqing was granted an iron tally of privilege.

literal: On guiwei day Liu Chen reported that Palace attendant Gao Keyuan and Central Capital regent judicial assistant Li Keju handled cases fairly and clearly; an edict ordered their exceptional promotion.
idiomatic: On guiwei day Liu Chen reported that Palace attendant Gao Keyuan and Central Capital regent judicial assistant Li Keju handled cases fairly and clearly, and an edict ordered their exceptional promotion.

literal: On jiashen day an edict ordered that among famine victims in all circuits who had pawned sons and daughters due to floods, counting from the first month of the coming year they would pay ten cash per day in hired labor wages until the pawn price was worked off, then be sent home.
idiomatic: On jiashen day an edict ordered that among flood victims in all circuits who had pawned sons and daughters, starting from the first month of the coming year they would pay ten cash per day in hired labor until the pawn price was worked off, then be sent home.

literal: Guizhou reported that its inhabitants had originally been relocated from Silla and had not learned writing; they requested schools be established to teach them, and the request was granted.
idiomatic: Guizhou reported that its inhabitants had originally been relocated from Silla and had not learned writing; they requested schools be established to teach them, and the request was granted.

literal: Guide, Longhua, Yikun, Shuang, Liao, Tong, and Zu — seven prefectures — from this time received an edict beginning to levy commercial taxes.
idiomatic: Guide, Longhua, Yikun, Shuang, Liao, Tong, and Zu — seven prefectures — from this time received an edict beginning to levy commercial taxes.

literal: On jichou day an edict ordered all garrison towns to build proclamation towers.
idiomatic: On jichou day an edict ordered all garrison towns to build proclamation towers.

literal: In the second year, spring, first month, on the guisi new moon Pei Xuangan was made Hanlin Academician-in-Attendance, Xing Xiang made Supervising Secretary, Shi Yongzhong Hanlin Academician, Lü Detui Privy Council Academician, Zhang Jian Political Affairs Attendant, Xing Baozhi promoted to Acting Minister of Works with Extraordinary Honorific Equal to Three Councillors and Concurrent Palace Grand Secretary, Wang Jizhong made Central Capital regent and Acting Grand Preceptor, Vice Minister of Revenue Liu Jing promoted to Minister of Works, imperial son-in-law Xiao Shaozong promoted to Acting Grand Preceptor, and Yelü Kongwen promoted to Political Affairs Commissioner and enfeoffed as King of You.
idiomatic: In the second year, on the guisi new moon of the first spring month, Pei Xuangan was appointed Hanlin Academician-in-Attendance, Xing Xiang Supervising Secretary, Shi Yongzhong Hanlin Academician, Lü Detui Privy Council Academician, and Zhang Jian Political Affairs Attendant; Xing Baozhi was promoted to Acting Minister of Works with Extraordinary Honorific Equal to Three Councillors and Concurrent Palace Grand Secretary; Wang Jizhong was made Central Capital regent and Acting Grand Preceptor; Vice Minister of Revenue Liu Jing was promoted to Minister of Works; imperial son-in-law Xiao Shaozong was promoted to Acting Grand Preceptor; and Yelü Kongwen was promoted to Political Affairs Commissioner and enfeoffed as King of You.

literal: On dingwei day the court went to Ruilu Plain.
idiomatic: On dingwei day the court went to Ruilu Plain.

literal: Northern Court Privy Council Commissioner Yelü Huage was enfeoffed as King of Bin.
idiomatic: Northern Court Privy Council Commissioner Yelü Huage was enfeoffed as King of Bin.

literal: The Ma clan was made Elegant Consort, the Geng clan Pure Consort, Palace Bed Attendant Bai Bright Consort, Palace Attire Attendant Li Gracious Consort, Palace Works Attendant Ai Fragrant Consort, and Palace Secretary Attendant Sun Harmonious Consort.
idiomatic: The Ma clan was made Elegant Consort, the Geng clan Pure Consort, Palace Bed Attendant Bai Bright Consort, Palace Attire Attendant Li Gracious Consort, Palace Works Attendant Ai Fragrant Consort, and Palace Secretary Attendant Sun Harmonious Consort.

literal: On jiwei day prisoners were reviewed.
idiomatic: On jiwei day the court reviewed prisoners.

literal: The Wugu and Dilie rebelled; Right Pishi Xiaowen commander Yanshou led troops to suppress them.
idiomatic: The Wugu and Dilie rebelled, and Right Pishi Xiaowen commander Yanshou led troops to suppress them.

literal: That month Dadan state troops besieged Zhen Prefecture; the prefectural army held firm and they soon withdrew.
idiomatic: That month Dadan state troops besieged Zhen Prefecture; the prefectural army held firm and the besiegers soon withdrew.

literal: Second month, on bingzi day an edict established Maiwu River as Xiangle County, Nühe River as Shenshui County, Luojia Army as Lüshan County, Shanzi River as Fushu County, Xijia Stockade as Longshan County, Alan Valley as Quannong County, Songshan River as Songshan County, and Jindianzi as Jinyuan County.
idiomatic: On bingzi day of the second month an edict established Maiwu River as Xiangle County, Nühe River as Shenshui County, Luojia Army as Lüshan County, Shanzi River as Fushu County, Xijia Stockade as Longshan County, Alan Valley as Quannong County, Songshan River as Songshan County, and Jindianzi as Jinyuan County.

literal: On renwu day Northern Court Privy Council Vice Commissioner Gao Zheng was dispatched to inspect prisons in all circuits.
idiomatic: On renwu day Northern Court Privy Council Vice Commissioner Gao Zheng was sent to inspect prisons in all circuits.

literal: Third month, on the renchen new moon, Huage because the Northwestern Route was largely pacified left troops to garrison Zhen Prefecture and went to the mobile court.
idiomatic: On the renchen new moon of the third month Huage, because the Northwestern Route was largely pacified, left troops to garrison Zhen Prefecture and went to the mobile court.

literal: Summer, fourth month, on jiazi day the sun was worshipped.
idiomatic: On jiazi day of the fourth summer month the court worshipped the sun.

literal: An edict granted the Upper Capital's request to register 25,400-plus households from Shanyu, Talu River, Feng, Hao, and other prefectures surveyed by Han Bin, establishing ten counties including Changba, Xingren, and Baohe.
idiomatic: An edict granted the Upper Capital's request to register more than 25,400 households from Shanyu, Talu River, Feng, Hao, and other prefectures surveyed by Han Bin, establishing ten counties including Changba, Xingren, and Baohe.

literal: On bingzi day the court went to Mianshan.
idiomatic: On bingzi day the court went to Mianshan.

literal: Fifth month, on the xinmao new moon, Huage and others were again ordered on a western campaign.
idiomatic: On the xinmao new moon of the fifth month Huage and others were again ordered on a western campaign.

literal: Sixth month, on the xinyou new moon, Censor Yelü Zizhong was dispatched as envoy to Goryeo to recover the six old prefectures.
idiomatic: On the xinyou new moon of the sixth month Censor Yelü Zizhong was sent as envoy to Goryeo to recover the six old prefectures.

literal: Autumn, seventh month, on renchen day the Wugu and Dilie all recovered their former territories.
idiomatic: On renchen day of the seventh autumn month the Wugu and Dilie all recovered their former territories.

literal: On yiwei day Southwestern Road pacification commissioner and Political Affairs Commissioner Xiezhen reported that rebel Tangut tribes had all fled north of the Yellow River to Mo'nanshan; non-rebel Hedang and Wumi tribes had occupied their lands and now had moved west again; when questioned they said they were following pasture and water, and if not dealt with early they might become a later menace.
idiomatic: On yiwei day Southwestern Road pacification commissioner and Political Affairs Commissioner Xiezhen reported that rebel Tangut tribes had all fled north of the Yellow River to Mo'nanshan; the non-rebel Hedang and Wumi tribes had occupied their lands and now had moved west again; when questioned they said they were following pasture and water, and if not dealt with early they might become a later menace.

literal: It was also heard that many rebels before and after had fled to Western Xia, which did not accept them.
idiomatic: It was also heard that many rebels before and after had fled to Western Xia, which did not accept them.

literal: An edict ordered envoys sent again to ask their intent in moving west; if they returned to their former lands, they could then be reassured and pacified on the spot.
idiomatic: An edict ordered envoys sent again to ask their intent in moving west; if they returned to their former lands, they could then be reassured and pacified on the spot.

literal: The envoys brought no reply; the Emperor was angered and wished to attack them.
idiomatic: The envoys brought no reply; the Emperor was angered and wished to attack them.

literal: Then an edict was sent to Li Dezhao: "Now the Tangut have rebelled; I wish to campaign west. You should strike east and not lose the pincer advantage.
idiomatic: Then an edict was sent to Li Dezhao: "Now the Tangut have rebelled; I wish to campaign west. You should strike east and not lose the pincer advantage.

literal: " Orders were also given for all armies to buy fat horses at market.
idiomatic: " Orders were also given for all armies to buy fat horses at market.

literal: On dingyou day tiyin Yelü Dilie was made Southern Court Grand Chancellor, and Grand Commandant Wuge was made tiyin.
idiomatic: On dingyou day tiyin Yelü Dilie was appointed Southern Court Grand Chancellor, and Grand Commandant Wuge was appointed tiyin.

literal: On guimao day the court fished at Qugou.
idiomatic: On guimao day the court fished at Qugou.

literal: On wushen day an edict ordered relief for the poor using interest from Dunmu Palace funds.
idiomatic: On wushen day an edict ordered relief for the poor using interest from Dunmu Palace funds.

literal: On jiyou day Huage and others defeated the forces of Zubu chief Wuba.
idiomatic: On jiyou day Huage and others defeated the forces of Zubu chief Wuba.

literal: On dingmao day Prince Zongxun was enfeoffed as Inner Palace tiyin.
idiomatic: On dingmao day Prince Zongxun was enfeoffed as Inner Palace tiyin.

literal: Eighth month, on renxu day Introducing Commissioner Li Yanhong was dispatched to grant King of Western Xia Li Dezhao and Princess Yicheng carriages and horses.
idiomatic: On renxu day of the eighth month Introducing Commissioner Li Yanhong was sent to grant King of Western Xia Li Dezhao and Princess Yicheng carriages and horses.

literal: On jichou day Yelü Zizhong returned from his mission to Goryeo.
idiomatic: On jichou day Yelü Zizhong returned from his mission to Goryeo.

literal: Winter, tenth month, on the jiwei new moon the court hunted north of Piaojing.
idiomatic: On the jiwei new moon of the tenth winter month the court hunted north of Piaojing.

literal: Yelü Aying and others were ordered as envoys to Song to congratulate the emperor's birthday.
idiomatic: Yelü Aying and others were ordered as envoys to Song to congratulate the emperor's birthday.

literal: On xinyou day the court halted at Changbo.
idiomatic: On xinyou day the court halted at Changbo.

literal: On bingyin day.
idiomatic: On bingyin day.

literal: Xiaowen commander Zhang Maliu presented a Jurchen who knew Goryeo affairs.
idiomatic: Xiaowen commander Zhang Maliu presented a Jurchen who knew Goryeo affairs.

literal: The Emperor questioned him; he said: "Three years ago I was captured by Goryeo and served as a court official, so I know.
idiomatic: The Emperor questioned him; he said: "Three years ago I was captured by Goryeo and served as a court official, so I know.

literal: From Kaegyeong eastward seven days' ride by horse there is a great fortress as large as Kaegyeong; rare tribute from neighboring prefectures is all stored there.
idiomatic: From Kaegyeong eastward seven days' ride by horse there is a great fortress as large as Kaegyeong; rare tribute from neighboring prefectures is all stored there.

literal: South of Seung, Na, and other prefectures there are also two great fortresses with similar stores.
idiomatic: South of Seung, Na, and other prefectures there are also two great fortresses with similar stores.

literal: If the great army marched by the forward route, taking Hasugwan Jurchen northward, crossing the Yalu River straight and proceeding up the great river to Gwak Prefecture to join the main road, Goryeo could be taken and possessed.
idiomatic: If the great army marched by the forward route, taking Hasugwan Jurchen northward, crossing the Yalu River straight and proceeding up the great river to Gwak Prefecture to join the main road, Goryeo could be taken and possessed.

literal: " The Emperor accepted it.
idiomatic: " The Emperor accepted it.

literal: Eleventh month, on jiawu day prisoners were reviewed.
idiomatic: On jiawu day of the eleventh month the court reviewed prisoners.

literal: On guichou day Privy Council Commissioner King of Bin Huage was stripped of rank and fief for faults in the western campaign and sent out as military commissioner of Datong Army.
idiomatic: On guichou day Privy Council Commissioner King of Bin Huage was stripped of rank and fief for faults in the western campaign and sent out as military commissioner of Datong Army.

literal: Twelfth month, on jiazi day Northern Court Great King Yelü Shiliang was made Northern Court Privy Council Commissioner and enfeoffed as King of Qi.
idiomatic: On jiazi day of the twelfth month Northern Court Great King Yelü Shiliang was made Northern Court Privy Council Commissioner and enfeoffed as King of Qi.

literal: Grand Chancellor Liu Sheng was put in charge of compiling the National History; Niu Lin was made military commissioner of Zhangguo Army; Xiao Xiaomu was made Northwestern Road pacification commissioner.
idiomatic: Grand Chancellor Liu Sheng was put in charge of compiling the National History; Niu Lin was made military commissioner of Zhangguo Army; and Xiao Xiaomu was made Northwestern Road pacification commissioner.

literal: Jinshi Xianyu Maozhao and five others passed the examinations.
idiomatic: Jinshi Xianyu Maozhao and five others passed the examinations.

literal: Third year, spring, first month, on jichou day prisoners were reviewed.
idiomatic: In the third year, on jichou day of the first spring month, the court reviewed prisoners.

literal: Zubu chief Wuba came to court and was enfeoffed as king.
idiomatic: Zubu chief Wuba came to court and was enfeoffed as king.

literal: On yiwei day the court went to the Hun River.
idiomatic: On yiwei day the court went to the Hun River.

literal: On dingyou day the Jurchen and Iron Li each sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: On dingyou day the Jurchen and Iron Li each sent envoys with tribute.

literal: That evening a comet appeared in the west.
idiomatic: That evening a comet appeared in the west.

literal: On bingwu day the court hunted on the Huang River banks.
idiomatic: On bingwu day the court hunted on the Huang River banks.

literal: On renzi day the Emperor and Empress hunted at Ruilu Plain.
idiomatic: On renzi day the Emperor and Empress hunted at Ruilu Plain.

literal: Second month, on wuwu day an edict increased the monthly salaries of those from Privy Council Commissioner downward.
idiomatic: On wuwu day of the second month an edict increased the monthly salaries of officials from Privy Council Commissioner downward.

literal: On jiazi day Upper Capital deputy regent Yelü Zizhong was again dispatched as envoy to Goryeo to recover the six old prefectures.
idiomatic: On jiazi day Upper Capital deputy regent Yelü Zizhong was again sent as envoy to Goryeo to recover the six old prefectures.

literal: Third month, on gengzi day Yelü Shiliang was dispatched to fortify Zhao Prefecture.
idiomatic: On gengzi day of the third month Yelü Shiliang was sent to fortify Zhao Prefecture.

literal: On wushen day transport commissioners were established in Nanjing, Fengsheng, Ping, Yu, Yun, Ying, Shuo, and other prefectures.
idiomatic: On wushen day transport commissioners were established in Nanjing, Fengsheng, Ping, Yu, Yun, Ying, Shuo, and other prefectures.

literal: Summer, fourth month, on wuwu day an edict ordered that within Nanjing's jurisdiction criminal cases should not be delayed so as not to hinder agricultural work.
idiomatic: On wuwu day of the fourth summer month an edict ordered that within Nanjing's jurisdiction criminal cases should not be delayed so as not to hinder agricultural work.

literal: On guihai day the Wugu rebelled.
idiomatic: On guihai day the Wugu rebelled.

literal: On yihai day Shazhou Uyghur Cao Shun sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: On yihai day Shazhou Uyghur Cao Shun sent envoys with tribute.

literal: On bingzi day Northwestern Road pacification surveillance commissioner Xiao Xiaomu was made Northern Court Grand Chancellor.
idiomatic: On bingzi day Northwestern Road pacification surveillance commissioner Xiao Xiaomu was appointed Northern Court Grand Chancellor.

literal: Fifth month, on the yiyou new moon the court went to Mianshan for the summer retreat.
idiomatic: On the yiyou new moon of the fifth month the court went to Mianshan for the summer retreat.

literal: Sixth month, on yihai day the two imperial maternal clans Bali and Yishi were merged into one tent, with Yishi Irbi Xiao Dilie made Xiaowen commander to oversee them.
idiomatic: On yihai day of the sixth month the two imperial maternal clans Bali and Yishi were merged into one tent, with Yishi Irbi Xiao Dilie appointed Xiaowen commander to oversee them.

literal: On jiashen day the Emperor's nephew Hudugu was enfeoffed as Prince of Guangping Commandery.
idiomatic: On jiashen day the Emperor's nephew Hudugu was enfeoffed as Prince of Guangping Commandery.

literal: That summer an edict ordered imperial maternal clan Xiaowen commander Xiao Dilie, Eastern Capital regent Yelü Tuanshi, and others to campaign against Goryeo, building a pontoon bridge on the Yalu River and fortifying Bao, Xuanyi, Dingyuan, and other prefectures.
idiomatic: That summer an edict ordered imperial maternal clan Xiaowen commander Xiao Dilie, Eastern Capital regent Yelü Tuanshi, and others to campaign against Goryeo, building a pontoon bridge on the Yalu River and fortifying Bao, Xuanyi, Dingyuan, and other prefectures.

literal: Autumn, seventh month, on the yiyou new moon the court went to Pingdi Pine Forest.
idiomatic: On the yiyou new moon of the seventh autumn month the court went to Pingdi Pine Forest.

literal: On renchen day an edict ordered the Political Affairs Department and Privy Council that appointments and releases granted during drinking should not be immediately executed but reported back the next day for confirmation.
idiomatic: On renchen day an edict ordered the Political Affairs Department and Privy Council that appointments and releases granted during drinking should not be immediately executed but reported back the next day for confirmation.

literal: Eighth month, on the jiayin new moon the court visited Shaling.
idiomatic: On the jiayin new moon of the eighth month the court visited Shaling.

literal: Ninth month, on dingyou day the eight tribes of Dilie killed their Xiaowen commander Shaowa and all rebelled; an edict ordered Southern Court Grand Chancellor Yelü Wulage to win them over.
idiomatic: On dingyou day of the ninth month the eight tribes of Dilie killed their Xiaowen commander Shaowa and all rebelled; an edict ordered Southern Court Grand Chancellor Yelü Wulage to win them over.

literal: On xinhai day several Dilie captives were released and ordered to persuade their people.
idiomatic: On xinhai day several Dilie captives were released and ordered to persuade their people.

literal: On renzi day Yelü Shiliang dispatched envoys presenting Dilie captives.
idiomatic: On renzi day Yelü Shiliang sent envoys presenting Dilie captives.

literal: Winter, tenth month, on the jiayin new moon the court visited the Central Capital.
idiomatic: On the jiayin new moon of the tenth winter month the court visited the Central Capital.

literal: On bingzi day Standard-and-Drum Zhualacha Xiaowen commander Tiligu was made Great King of the Xi Six Divisions.
idiomatic: On bingzi day Standard-and-Drum Zhualacha Xiaowen commander Tiligu was made Great King of the Xi Six Divisions.

literal: Jinshi Zhang Yongxing and thirty others passed the examinations.
idiomatic: Jinshi Zhang Yongxing and thirty others passed the examinations.

literal: Fourth year, spring, first month, on yiyou day the court went to Ruilu Plain.
idiomatic: In the fourth year, on yiyou day of the first spring month, the court went to Ruilu Plain.

literal: On bingxu day an edict ordered Yelü Shiliang to campaign again against the Dilie.
idiomatic: On bingxu day an edict ordered Yelü Shiliang to campaign again against the Dilie.

literal: On wuzi day Xiaowen commander Bagu was ordered to dam water at Ruilu Plain in preparation for the spring hunt.
idiomatic: On wuzi day Xiaowen commander Bagu was ordered to dam water at Ruilu Plain in preparation for the spring hunt.

literal: On dingyou day the court hunted at Malan Marsh.
idiomatic: On dingyou day the court hunted at Malan Marsh.

literal: On renyin day the eastern campaign began.
idiomatic: On renyin day the eastern campaign began.

literal: Eastern Capital regent Shanning and Grand Secretary Nielihun reported that they had assembled the great army and Jurchen tribal troops for a divided advance; envoys were then dispatched carrying a secret edict to the army front.
idiomatic: Eastern Capital regent Shanning and Grand Secretary Nielihun reported that they had assembled the great army and Jurchen tribal troops for a divided advance; envoys were then sent carrying a secret edict to the army front.

literal: Second month, on the renzi new moon the court went to Sadi Marsh.
idiomatic: On the renzi new moon of the second month the court went to Sadi Marsh.

literal: Khotan sent tribute.
idiomatic: Khotan sent tribute.

literal: Summer, fourth month, on guichou day Linqiya Jianfu was made Northern Court Great King.
idiomatic: On guichou day of the fourth summer month Linqiya Jianfu was made Northern Court Great King.

literal: On jiayin day Xiao Dilie and others returned from the campaign against Goryeo.
idiomatic: On jiayin day Xiao Dilie and others returned from the campaign against Goryeo.

literal: On bingchen day the Hasugwan tribe requested registration of Jurchen Wang Shuzhini households previously unlisted, enrolling their adult males for taxation and corvée; the request was granted.
idiomatic: On bingchen day the Hasugwan tribe requested registration of Jurchen Wang Shuzhini households previously unlisted, enrolling their adult males for taxation and corvée, and the request was granted.

literal: Privy Council Commissioner Guanning reported a great defeat of the eight tribes of Dilie; an edict ordered attendant Sala to convey commendation, performing the hand-clasp ceremony in his place.
idiomatic: Privy Council Commissioner Guanning reported a great defeat of the eight tribes of Dilie; an edict ordered attendant Sala to convey commendation, performing the hand-clasp ceremony in his place.
